text:
kyle_finance: Heads-up  Avenue Health flagged INV-2027-05. They were billed $1,900 in burst overage for May 14 and are asking for the overage to be removed because they say the spike was caused by a platform degradation + a third-party network event.

anya_sales: Context  Avenue has a Dedicated commit (3xA100 equiv) $11,000/mo. On May 14 they had a traffic surge during our failover window; their SREs also noticed packet drops to a partner region at the same time.

omar_csm: Support case CASE-15802 has their logs: https://redwood.at/support/CASE-15802. They show retry loops 12:05-14:30 UTC and say billing needs to be corrected before their finance close. :frowning:

ops_riley: Infra telemetry shows a routing flap at 12:06 that caused elevated tails for ~1.8h. Separately, our network partner reported an intermittent egress throttling event affecting some regions from 12:10-12:45. Measured partial degradation window (our metric) = 1.9h. Root cause summary will be in the case.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2027-05: Reserved commit = $11,000; Burst/overage = $1,900; SLA credit applied = $0; Total = $12,900.

kyle_finance: SLA table: "Partial degradation >1h and <2h -> 10% credit of monthly Dedicated fee." 10% of $11,000 = $1,100. Options: (A) apply SLA credit $1,100 only -> invoice = $11,800 (keep overage), (B) waive overage $1,900 + apply SLA credit $1,100 = total concession $3,000 -> invoice = $9,900. Note: waiving overage = one-time revenue write-off; SLA credit = contractual credit.

anya_sales: Customer is pushing for the overage to be removed (they want $1,900 gone). They also asked if we can offset the concession against next month's invoice rather than refunding now.

ops_riley: Ops accepts responsibility for the routing flap; partner event was external and partially amplified retries. We're happy to support a waiver recommendation. We can open a recovery request with partner, but that will take time.

kyle_finance: Question for RevOps: can we approve Option B (waive overage + SLA credit) and record as a write-off now, then pursue vendor recovery separately? We need GL guidance for month-end.

dina_revops: I can approve up to $4k one-off concessions with ops RCA. Option B total concession $3,000 fits. Approve with condition that ops files vendor recovery ticket and we track it separately. Please add a one-line RCA to CASE-15802.

anya_sales: Customer ok with credit applied to this invoice; they prefer it not rolled into next month.

kyle_finance: Approved per @dina_revops. Recording: concession_type=one_time_writeoff; waived_overage=$1,900; sla_credit=$1,100; total_concession=$3,000. I'll generate corrected invoice INV-2027-05-C and credit memo CM-2027-178 and update AR/GL.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2027-178 created. Corrected invoice INV-2027-05-C issued.

ops_riley: Filed vendor recovery ticket with partner (VND-7712) and added RCA to CASE-15802. Will update when partner responds.

omar_csm: Draft to customer: "Thanks  we've applied a $3,000 concession (SLA credit + one-time waiver) and issued corrected invoice INV-2027-05-C. We're sorry for the disruption; CASE-15802 now includes the RCA and we've opened a vendor recovery request. Please reach out if you need the credit memo PDF." Sending after finance posts docs.

anya_sales: Customer replied: "Thanks  we appreciate the quick handling. Please keep us posted on vendor follow-up." :thumbsup:
